capability.summary: Run TypeScript tsc --noEmit in one local project directory
capability.description: Runs exactly `tsc --noEmit` with cwd set to the supplied directory or an existing file's absolute parent. It performs configured TypeScript compilation/type checking without JavaScript/declaration emit, and returns raw compiler streams in a JSON envelope.
capability.problem_space: Project-level TypeScript compiler/type-check validation under discovered tsconfig settings with fixed --noEmit; not JavaScript bundling, artifact emission, test execution, ESLint, formatting, package installation, or caller-configurable tsc commands.

env_requirements: a usable tsconfig.json and referenced TypeScript dependencies/types discoverable from the resolved cwd
constraint.io_signature: Input: required project_dir string at CLI position 1; a directory becomes cwd and an existing file selects its absolute parent. Executes `tsc --noEmit`. Output: JSON envelope with compiler exit_code and raw stdout/stderr.
accepted_inputs: an existing TypeScript project directory containing or inheriting a tsconfig.json
an existing file whose parent directory is intentionally used as the TypeScript project cwd
constraint.output_shape: tsc exit 0: {status: "success", tool: "tsc", target: string, exit_code: 0, result: null, stdout: string, stderr: string|null}, wrapper exit 0. Any nonzero tsc exit: same keys with status="tool_error" and the compiler exit code is propagated. Missing target, executable, or 120-second timeout: {status: "error", tool: "tsc", message: string}, exiting 2/3/4. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON.
limitations: fixed `--noEmit` prevents normal JavaScript/declaration output, but project incremental/composite configuration and TypeScript version may still affect cache or build-info behavior; it is not an absolute filesystem-write sandbox

the plain string project_dir contract accepts either an existing directory or an existing file; automatic file-artifact binding does not infer a directory, and a file is converted to its absolute parent cwd
uses cwd/tsconfig discovery and exposes no project path flag, target, module, strictness, pretty, incremental, build-mode, or file-selection controls
does not bundle code, run tests, lint with ESLint, install dependencies, or return parsed diagnostics
uses a fixed 120-second timeout and captures untruncated compiler output in memory

output_contract.description: JSON execution envelope containing `tsc --noEmit` exit code and raw compiler stdout/stderr; no compiled JavaScript artifact is returned.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: type check a TypeScript project with tsc
run tsc noEmit and capture compiler errors
negative_intents: emit bundle or transpile JavaScript artifacts
